verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents each piece of the story as its own feature: ESOP management and issuing equity to employees (docs-7, docs-8), vesting schedules and built-in e-signing (docs-10, docs-11), board resolutions and voting (docs-24, docs-25), and in-house 409A valuations (docs-4, docs-28, docs-30). Nothing shows these pieces connected into one end-to-end option-grant workflow. missing for 10: evidence that board approval gates the option grant, evidence that the 409A value automatically sets the strike price, documentation of a single integrated grant flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of option issuance.
